info.title: ACE Music
info.description: Create songs from ideas or lyrics, import an authorized reference MP3, cover a track, combine two tracks, write lyrics and retrieve original tasks. Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples. Start: https://platform.acedata.cloud/services/024e09b4-52cf-5e98-a91a-efedf43104c4?from=coze&utm_source=coze&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=evergreen&utm_content=coze_acemusic_setup

data.description: One track for a successful upload, or two candidates for a complete generate/cover/mashup group. A partial group may retain only its successful candidate.
One track for a successful upload, or two candidates for a complete generate/cover/mashup group. A partial group may retain only its successful candidate.

200.description: Request accepted or result available. Generation, cover and mashup target two tracks; upload targets one. Inspect the original task state before treating it as complete.

202.description: Durable task accepted. Save task_id and query the original task; this is not a completed result.

400.description: Invalid request, unsupported model/action or incompatible references.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reuse the same key for the same creation request to retrieve its original task. A different payload with the same key is rejected.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples.

post.description: Generate, cover or mash up one group of two song candidates, or import one MP3 audio reference from an HTTPS URL. Complete two-track groups and successful one-track imports have separate prices. Final failed or partial generation groups are free. Save the original task ID and query it instead of resubmitting. Full input requirements: https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/acemusic-audios Submit once with async=true. Retain task_id and poll the matching task tool; a task ID is not a completed result. Do not resubmit while pending.

name.description: Optional display name for an upload.

async.description: Return a persistent task ID; query /acemusic/tasks for the result.

lyric.description: Lyrics for custom generation, cover or mashup.

model.description: Generation supports both models. Cover and mashup use acemusic-v1.1. Omit for upload.

style.description: Musical style for custom generation, cover or mashup.

title.description: Required for custom generation; optional for cover and mashup.

action.description: generate creates new songs, upload imports one MP3 audio reference, cover reworks one owned track, and mashup blends exactly two owned tracks.

custom.description: Only used by generate: false for an idea, true for supplied lyrics.

prompt.description: Creation idea. Required when custom is false.

audio_id.description: Public platform track ID owned by the caller. Required for cover; optional on upload to associate the import with an existing reference track.

audio_url.description: HTTPS URL of an MP3 source file for upload. Use audio_id or mashup_audio_ids for already imported or generated tracks.

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS callback for the final result. Implies asynchronous execution.

audio_influence.description: Audio reference strength for cover and mashup. Defaults to 60.

mashup_audio_ids.description: Exactly two distinct caller-owned public track IDs. The selected references must be compatible with each other.

200.description: Request accepted or result available. Inspect the task state before treating generation as complete.

202.description: Durable task accepted. Save task_id and query the original task; this is not a completed result.

post.description: Generate a title and editable lyrics. This is a separate paid operation; generating a song does not implicitly invoke it. Full input requirements: https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/acemusic-lyrics

post.description: Retrieve only tasks owned by the authenticated caller. Polling is free and remains available with a zero balance; authentication and API permissions are required. Full input requirements: https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/acemusic-tasks A non-null response can be a progress snapshot. Require terminal success and a non-empty primary media URL or content, not just a cover image or an empty data array.

limit.description: Alternative history page size; use page/page_size or limit/offset consistently.

created_at_max.description: Inclusive creation-time upper bound, Unix seconds.

created_at_min.description: Inclusive creation-time lower bound, Unix seconds.

schema.description: Page and page_size cannot be mixed with limit or offset. The resulting offset must not exceed 10000. Missing or foreign task IDs return 404 on retrieve and are omitted from batch results.
